mapper.delete: delete from t_user_grade where u_id = #{userId} and g_id = #{gradeId}
mapper.select: select distinct g_id from ( select ug.g_id as g_id from t_user_grade ug where ug.u_id = #{userId} and (ug.is_deleted = 0 or ug.is_deleted is null) union select u.grade_id as g_id from t_user u where u.id = #{userId} and u.grade_id is not null ) t where g_id is not null
